exposure: ART subtype (in vitro fertilisation (IVF/ICSI), frozen embryo transfer (FET), oocyte donor receptors (ODR), insemination)
cohort: The study included 29,529 singleton pregnancies attended at Hospital Universitari Dexeus between 2008 and 2019, excluding women under 18 years, with pregestational diabetes, metformin use prior to pregnancy, or multiple pregnancies.
finding: Despite a higher crude prevalence of GDM in ART pregnancies, ART itself was not associated with an increased risk of GDM when adjusting for age, parity, and BMI.
mod_finding: Among women with GDM, those who conceived via ART had significantly higher C-section rates compared to those who conceived spontaneously.
